text: Trump in Manila, then China
Trump meets Marcos, then arrives in China. A first Trump–Xi–Putin trilateral is expected on 19 November.
Gulf bases under fire
Iran strikes Kuwait and Bahrain; says it targeted a US base after US strikes on Qeshm Island.
Crimea bridge hit again
Traffic halted after a third attack this week, Russian-installed governor says.
Border war fears rise
Ethiopia and Eritrea amass forces along their shared border, sources say.
Workers demand more
Bangladesh garment workers block a highway; at least 30 factories close.
One light-day away
Voyager 1 reaches a 24-hour radio-signal distance from Earth, CNN reports.
Gang stronghold hit
Salvadoran forces destroy a Haitian gang leader’s house in Canaan.
Artists push back on AI
At Australia’s ARIAs, Elton John backs artists seeking consent and payment.
Winter smog grips cities; Al Jazeera details the health risks.
Carney announces Trump meeting at APEC over trade. [NYT / JS]
Israel launches a central-Gaza operation as families flee. [BBC]
Anthropic prices IPO shares at $83; trading due Thursday. [NYT]
